Li: Quick midshift check — queue is ticking up. Currently 47 open tickets, 3 P1s (two related to embeddings), avg SLA wait ~38m. I updated the macros draft for embedding retries; looking for quick sign-off. Also flagging customer-1123 for manual follow-up.

support-bot: New ticket ingest: #3489 (embedding-failure) from customer-1123. Priority: P2. Link: https://zendesk.example/3489

Jamal: taking P1 #3471 (data-loss) — will triage now and loop in infra if needed.

Anya: saw the macro diff. Two wording nits: remove 'please escalate' (we auto-assign) and add a link to the eval checklist. Otherwise looks good.

Tom: embedding failures — anyone seen this after the throttle change yesterday? I saw a spike in 5xxs for the embedding service from 10:05-10:18. runbook suggests dropping to fallback model if >30% errors. thoughts?

Li: yep, I observed same. I toggled the embedding-retry macro to recommend `--retry 3` and a manual KV cache flush for customers hitting stale keys. Proposed macro snippet:```
Macro: embedding-retry
- Step 1: Retry request up to 3 times with exponential backoff (200ms, 400ms, 800ms)
- Step 2: If errors persist, switch to `text-embed-small-v1` fallback for 2 calls then requeue to primary
- Step 3: Notify infra if >5 failures in 15m for same customer
```

Jamal: sounds reasonable. I'll run the A/B on wording: 'switch to fallback' vs 'use fallback model' — lighter phrasing probably reduces confusion. I can push change in 10m.

Anya: approved on content. Adding eval checklist link: https://docs.redwood.ai/evals/embed-failures to the macro. Also propose a short note for CS: "Recommend retry first, then escalate to infra if recurring."

Li: great — @Jamal if you can push the macro edit please include the eval link and the CS note. I'll ping infra if we see another spike.

support-bot: Macro update queued by Jamal. Change ID: mu-2026-112. Preview: https://console.redwood/macro/mu-2026-112

Tom: if infra wants to roll back yesterday's throttle, we should coordinate with deployments slack. I'll stand by.

Jamal: pushed edit + applied to support templates. Will monitor for regressions. Reporting back in 20m. :thumbsup:

Li: thanks — quick checklist for next messages: 1) watch P1s (3471, 3478, 3482) 2) CS follow-up for customer-1123 3) macro live, monitor errors. Back to triage.

Anya: noted. If anyone needs me for CS copy or macro wording, ping.

support-bot: Alert: ticket #3478 escalated to P1 (automated). Notifying oncall.
